engines.name: Hugging Face
engines.purpose: Reference integration for model development, correctness checks, and portable Python experiments.
engines.best_deployment: Use Selected Context. Native Memory has a bounded post-fix batch-one Qwen/CUDA mechanism gate, not current workload qualification.

capability_scopes.native_memory: bounded post-fix mechanism gate; workload economics NOT_MEASURED

engines.recommended_today: Selected Context; keep Native Memory within the declared controlled gate.
engines.summary: The reference runtime supports typed resources and a bounded same-consumer Native Memory gate. Cross-family and workload economics from pre-gate artifacts are quarantined.
requirements: A model adapter supported by the runtime
quickstart: pra runtime serve Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B -e hf --storage balanced

metrics.name: Post-fix same-consumer gate
metrics.value: 7/7 token-exact; max logit delta 0; zero selected-history re-encoding and persistent K/V copy

engines.selected_context_when: Choose it for maximum engine portability, new models, and workloads without repeated immutable evidence.
engines.native_memory_when: Use only to reproduce the named batch-one Qwen/CUDA gate until clean exact-identity workload reruns pass.
limitations: No production scheduler ownership
Pre-gate cross-family and workload measurements are quarantined
Current native evidence is limited to the declared batch-one Qwen/CUDA geometry
troubleshooting: Run pra doctor in the same Python environment as the CLI
Use pra model validate before enabling a native profile
engines.production_recommendation: Use Selected Context; do not promote Native Memory from the quarantined bundle measurements.

engines.name: vLLM
engines.purpose: High-throughput CUDA serving with continuous batching and automatic prefix caching.
engines.best_deployment: Selected Context is qualified. Native CUDA correctness and concurrency are promising but matched economics remain pending.
engines.recommended_today: Selected Context through the gateway or ordinary vLLM API.

capability_scopes.native_memory: bounded post-fix scheduler-page gate; workload economics NOT_MEASURED

engines.summary: A bounded post-fix scheduler-page alias gate passes exactness, lifecycle, and copy-accounting checks. Earlier connector throughput and recovery counts are quarantined.

metrics.name: Post-fix scheduler-page alias gate
metrics.value: 7 turns and 14 concurrent borrowers exact; zero K/V copy, H2D, and selected-history re-encoding

engines.selected_context_when: Choose it for production throughput today, especially when prefix caching already captures reuse.
engines.native_memory_when: Reconsider after matched cold, hot, warm, APC, transfer, and tail-latency rows are qualified.
limitations: Current CUDA gate is in-process V1 with complete pages and one homogeneous K/V group
Pre-gate connector throughput is quarantined
Final HBM, transfer, and tail-latency economics are incomplete
troubleshooting: Inspect the effective gateway and engine capabilities
Treat a missing native receipt as Selected Context, not silent native execution
engines.production_recommendation: Deploy Selected Context; keep Native Memory and Native Serving experimental.

engines.name: SGLang
engines.purpose: Structured generation and cache-aware serving with RadixAttention and hierarchical cache facilities.
engines.best_deployment: Selected Context is the default. Native Memory has a bounded post-fix companion mechanism gate; distributed and workload economics remain pending.

capability_scopes.native_memory: bounded post-fix companion gate; workload economics NOT_MEASURED

engines.recommended_today: Use Selected Context; keep the companion Native Memory path within its declared controlled gate.
engines.summary: The post-fix interval-addressed companion consumer passes bounded same-consumer and lifecycle checks. Earlier matched and lifecycle cohorts are quarantined.
requirements: Supported SGLang server or companion runner

metrics.name: Post-fix same-consumer and lifecycle gate
metrics.value: 7/7 token- and final-logit-exact; zero selected-history re-encoding, selection pack bytes, and allocator delta

engines.selected_context_when: Choose it when ordinary Radix/prefix behavior is sufficient or native placement has not been qualified.
engines.native_memory_when: Use only within the named companion mechanism gate until corrected distributed and workload reruns pass.
limitations: Pre-gate matched and lifecycle cohorts are quarantined
Distributed HiCache placement is not fully lifecycle-managed
Concurrent cold/warm tail curves remain incomplete
troubleshooting: Never return selected native detail to the ordinary Radix cache pool
Verify cleanup and one-copy attachment per request
engines.production_recommendation: Use Selected Context; treat Native Serving as a measured deployment project, not a flag.

engines.name: OpenVINO
engines.purpose: Intel CPU and integrated-GPU inference through OpenVINO GenAI or OVMS.
engines.best_deployment: Selected Context through an ordinary OpenVINO prompt path.
engines.summary: Selected Context reduces input and latency on the measured Intel cohorts. No legitimate detached native-memory seam is qualified.
quickstart: pra gateway serve --mode selected-context --backend custom --backend-url http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1
engines.selected_context_when: Choose it for Intel deployments where token reduction improves prefill and process work.
engines.native_memory_when: Do not plan around it until OpenVINO exposes and qualifies a detached non-prefix memory seam.
limitations: Quality remains selector and workload dependent
No qualified Native Memory path
troubleshooting: Freeze selector output when comparing full and selected prompts
Record device, model conversion, and OpenVINO versions
engines.production_recommendation: Use Selected Context and report quality together with token and latency reduction.

engines.name: TensorRT-LLM
engines.purpose: Optimized NVIDIA inference using compiled engines and paged serving primitives.
engines.best_deployment: Selected Context through the compatible request path.
engines.recommended_today: Selected Context after local model and engine validation.
engines.summary: The transport and runtime boundary are defined, but native quality and economics are not yet qualified.
requirements: TensorRT-LLM engine built for the model
quickstart: pra gateway serve --mode selected-context --backend custom --backend-url http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1
engines.selected_context_when: Choose it when a conventional TensorRT-LLM engine is already operational.
engines.native_memory_when: Wait for a versioned native attention seam and matched quality/economic evidence.
limitations: No qualified native-memory implementation in the product runtime
Engine builds are model and hardware specific
troubleshooting: Validate the ordinary endpoint before adding typed transport
Do not infer native support from paged-cache support alone
engines.production_recommendation: Use Selected Context; native modes are not yet product-qualified.

engines.name: AirLLM
engines.purpose: Layer-streamed inference for models that exceed accelerator memory.
engines.best_deployment: Selected Context; it reduces visible work without adding a separate native reference pass.
engines.summary: Native memory is semantically feasible but slower in the measured request path, including warm reuse.
requirements: Sufficient host or storage capacity for streamed layers
quickstart: pra gateway serve --mode selected-context --backend custom --backend-url http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1
engines.selected_context_when: Choose it for current AirLLM deployments, especially one-shot or low-reuse resources.
engines.native_memory_when: Only investigate workloads where a large immutable resource is reused enough to amortize both reference encoding and layer streaming.
limitations: Warm reuse did not remove request-path overhead
Beyond-VRAM native CUDA validation remains incomplete
troubleshooting: Measure disabled, preselected, and routed paths separately
Attribute reference encoding and per-layer transfer independently
engines.production_recommendation: Prefer Selected Context; keep Native Memory research-only.

engines.name: llama.cpp
engines.purpose: Portable local inference across CPU, Metal, CUDA, and other backends.
engines.best_deployment: Selected Context through prompts or a compatible server.
engines.summary: Ordinary slot and session cache state is sequential prefix state, not automatically PRA Native Memory. A separate experimental sequence-attachment seam requires explicit qualification.
quickstart: pra gateway serve --mode selected-context --backend llama_cpp --backend-url http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1
engines.selected_context_when: Choose it for portable local deployments and unmodified upstream builds.
engines.native_memory_when: Only with a pinned PRA-aware backend receipt and exact isolation, parity, and lifecycle tests.
limitations: Prefix/session cache reuse is not detached semantic memory
Native attachment is not part of the stock public runtime
troubleshooting: Do not label slot reuse as Native Memory
Require model fingerprint and backend revision in any native capability receipt
engines.production_recommendation: Use Selected Context with stock llama.cpp.

engines.name: Ollama
engines.purpose: Local model packaging and a simple HTTP serving surface.
engines.best_deployment: Selected Context through the gateway and Ollama API.
engines.recommended_today: Selected Context with keep-alive tuned to the workload.
engines.summary: Keep-alive can improve reuse, but it remains ordinary model lifecycle behavior. Deeper native use requires a validated PRA-aware backend capability handshake.
quickstart: pra gateway serve --mode selected-context --backend ollama --backend-url http://127.0.0.1:11434

metrics.name: Selected prompt latency
metrics.value: Improved on current 14B HotpotQA/QASPER cohorts; quality is workload dependent

engines.selected_context_when: Choose it for stock Ollama installations and broad model compatibility.
engines.native_memory_when: Only when the backend returns a validated protocol, model fingerprint, mechanism list, and lifecycle receipt.
limitations: Keep-alive is not detached semantic memory
Quality gains depend on selection quality
troubleshooting: Treat malformed or stale capability receipts as Selected Context
Invalidate native receipts on model switch or unload
engines.production_recommendation: Use Selected Context; deeper integration is opt-in and receipt-gated.
